description: The outcome of a test delivery

ok.description: Whether the receiver answered with a 2xx status

http_status.description: The HTTP status of the answer; null when the request got none

duration_ms.description: How long the request took in milliseconds

response.description: The first 2 KB of the receiver's answer, with the URL and secrets hidden; null when there was none

error.description: Why it failed, without the URL or any secret; null when it succeeded
